concerns.text: T103 is declared parallel with T101 ('T101, T102, T103 (parallel)'), but T103 explicitly consumes T101's output: 'Record SHA-256 checksums of downloaded files via code/ingest/checksum.py' — checksum.py is repaired/produced by T101. This is a consumer-before-producer dependency inside the parallel group. Either mark T103 as depending on T101 (e.g. run T101 → {T102, T103}) or move checksum recording out of T103.
